subject: SaturnAI renewal kickoff — timeline, capacity ask & QBR availability
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@saturnai.com>, Marcus Thompson <mthompson@saturnai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SaturnAI renewal kickoff — timeline, capacity ask & QBR availability

Hi Elena / Marcus,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to kick off the renewal conversation and map out a clear runway for the next 12–24 months. A few things we want to align on in this thread so your teams have a single place for the plan:

- Renewal window and term options (12 vs 24 months)
- Capacity change request you mentioned (prep for +40% token volume during Q4)
- Pricing scenarios and procurement lead times
- QBR scheduling for a joint technical + commercial readout

Proposed near-term timeline:
1) This week: share mutual action plan draft (attached) and proposed pricing scenarios
2) Week of 3/15: QBR to review capacity forecast, runbook and pricing options
3) Week of 3/22: Finalize term decision and procurement milestones

QBR availability: we have open slots Thu 3/18 10–11am PT, Fri 3/19 9–10am PT, or Mon 3/22 11–12pm PT. If none work, happy to run a calendar poll.

Elena — can you confirm the internal stakeholders on your side who should join the QBR (tech ops, procurement, security)? Also can you confirm the target term and whether you want us to include a 24-month pricing scenario?

I've attached a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan for your review. Happy to iterate.

Best,

—Lauren Bishop
Account Exec, Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SaturnAI_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Elena Soto <elena@saturnai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Thompson <mthompson@saturnai.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:03:21 -07:00
Subject: Re: SaturnAI renewal kickoff — timeline, capacity ask & QBR availability

Lauren — thanks for pulling this together and for the clear timeline.

Quick answers:
- Stakeholders: Marcus (VP Ops), myself (Head of ML infra), plus procurement (Dorothy Park, dorothy@saturnai.com) and security (I can loop in Greg from security once we lock a date).
- Term: We're leaning toward 24 months if the pricing delta is reasonable — please include that scenario.
- Capacity: The +40% projection is accurate for our peak; the conv-rate improvements will hold through Q4. We'll need a short runway for added GPUs and a test migration window.

QBR: Thu 3/18 10–11am PT works best for our execs — can you lock that? If possible, can you include a short ops readout (15 minutes) showing how Redwood handles burst routing and KV cache warmup for our workload?

Also, can you confirm lead time for procurement paperwork (we're multi-entity, may need a 2–3 week signature runway)?

Thanks — Elena

Elena Soto
Head of ML Infrastructure
SaturnAI

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SaturnAI renewal kickoff — timeline, capacity ask & QBR availability

Looping in internally with a quick ops + pricing note before we confirm the QBR slot.

Notes from ops/pricing side:
- We should prepare three pricing scenarios: 12-mo, 24-mo standard uplift, 24-mo committed-throughput discount with a burst buffer. I'll scaffold figures in pricing-scenarios.xlsx.
- For procurement: Rishi should be the lead on contract SLAs and David Kim on billing/PO requirements; plan for a 10–20 business day review depending on legal redlines.
- Ops: we can demo a 10–15 minute ops readout covering routing/fallback and KV cache behavior; recommend 15 minutes and then 30–45 minutes for commercial discussion.

Action items (internal):
1) Lauren — confirm QBR slot and invite list
2) Rishi — prepare SLA/term notes and a list of likely redlines
3) Monica — complete the pricing scenarios and attach to the thread (ETA 3/15)

—Monica
Account Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@saturnai.com>, Marcus Thompson <mthompson@saturnai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SaturnAI renewal kickoff — timeline, capacity ask & QBR availability

Elena / Marcus — locking Thu 3/18 10–11am PT for the joint QBR. Calendar invite & agenda (short ops readout + pricing scenarios + procurement milestones) sent via calendar poll: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/3JX9Q

Confirmed attendees (please add Dorothy from procurement and Greg from security if you want them in the invite):
- Elena Soto — Head of ML Infrastructure (SaturnAI)
- Marcus Thompson — VP Ops (SaturnAI)
- Lauren Bishop — Account Exec (Redwood)
- Monica Patel — Account Strategy (Redwood)
- Rishi Malhotra — Commercial/Legal (Redwood)

Attachments: "pricing-scenarios.xlsx" (spreadsheet with 3 scenarios: 12-mo baseline, 24-mo standard, 24-mo committed-with-burst).

Next steps:
- Monica to post final numbers by 3/15 EOD (done)
- Rishi to surface any SLA/term change recommendations by 3/16
- Lauren to prepare the QBR agenda and ops demo script (15m ops + 30m commercial)
- Elena to confirm additional SaturnAI attendees by EOD 3/16

Procurement lead time note: Rishi flagged a likely 10–15 business day review if legal requests are modest — we'll try to compress where possible but flag multi-entity signatures up-front.

If anything changes I'll update the invite. Looking forward to the discussion.

Best,

—Lauren Bishop
Account Exec, Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing-scenarios.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)
